links.outcome: ChatGPT-5.1 accuracy versus consultants, residents, CCHR and logistic model for predicting CT findings
links.effect: Probabilistic model accuracy 74.0%, consultants 69.3%, residents 66.9%; rule-based ChatGPT sensitivity 91.8%, specificity 22.2%; ER-simulation ChatGPT accuracy 54.3%; consultants outperformed ER simulation (p = 0.01).
links.quote: Consultants outperformed the ER simulation model (p = 0.01), while their performance was similar to that of the probabilistic model (p = 0.44).

unlisted_practices: Comparing different prompting frameworks (ER physician simulation vs rule/literature-based) for LLM clinical decision-making

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of an LLM prompted under different simulation frameworks compared to physicians and clinical rules on patient data, assessing diagnostic accuracy rather than a specific deployment guardrail or organizational intervention.
